description: Claim set for money-moving backends: exactly-once effects, acknowledged durability, constraint integrity, audit-preserving recovery. Domain-specific claims (no negative balance, double-entry conservation) must be authored per system — they are the claims only you can state.
authorYourself: Balance conservation: sum of postings per transaction == 0 (double-entry) — model with kv/idempotent starters extended by amount state.
No negative balance under concurrent debits — concurrency domain; requires interleaving adversary in step.
Idempotency-key retention >= chargeback window — assumption + probe on retention config.
